# Pasi

> Pasi is a startup building a mobile investment platform that gives retail users in Venezuela and Latin America access to U.S. equity markets. Users buy tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs using stablecoins (USDC, USDT), with on-chain settlement on Solana via Jupiter aggregator. The app is live at https://app.pasi.capital.

## About

- [Homepage](https://pasi.capital/): Main marketing site (Spanish).
- [How Pasi works](https://pasi.capital/como-funciona): Step-by-step explanation of how to invest in U.S. stocks from Venezuela using USDT or USDC.
- [Security and custody](https://pasi.capital/seguridad): Non-custodial architecture (each user has a wallet in their own name, created with Privy), on-chain transparency, and compliance posture.
- [Help / FAQ](https://pasi.capital/ayuda): Common questions about Pasi, xStocks, stablecoin deposits, fees, withdrawals, and Solana settlement.
- [About / Team](https://pasi.capital/nosotros): Built by Venezuelans who lived through the same financial exclusion they're solving.
- [Web app](https://app.pasi.capital): Sign up and invest from the phone's browser.

## Education

- [Cómo empezar a invertir](https://pasi.capital/aprende): A five-minute beginner's guide in Spanish by Gabriel Bagdadi, founder of Pasi, for Venezuelans who already save in dollars and want to start investing. Covers inflation, stocks, bonds, ETFs, compound interest, and how to recognize an investment scam. Educational content with cited sources.
- [Blog de Pasi](https://pasi.capital/blog): Spanish-language articles on investing in the U.S. stock market with digital dollars, how Pasi works, and step-by-step guides. RSS feed: https://pasi.capital/blog/feed.xml

## Concepts

Most assets on Pasi are **xStocks**: tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs issued by Backed (owned by Kraken), 1:1 backed by underlying shares custodied with a regulated broker.

All assets settle on Solana via the Jupiter aggregator. Users fund accounts with USDC or USDT and gain on-chain price exposure to companies like Apple, Tesla, NVIDIA, and ETFs like SPY — without needing a U.S. bank account or a traditional broker.

Pasi plans to eventually integrate the Bolsa de Caracas (Caracas Stock Exchange) to expand access to local Venezuelan equities.

## Deposits

Users deposit USDT or USDC from Binance, Kontigo or any digital wallet. Identity verification (KYC) is required once, before the first deposit. Deposits in bolívares or other local currencies are not available yet.

## Withdrawals

Users withdraw USDT or USDC on the Solana network to external wallets or to exchanges such as Binance. Withdrawals to Kontigo or in local currency are not available yet.

## Fees

Pasi charges 0.5% of each trade or 1 USD, whichever is higher, and never more than 2.5% of the trade. The first purchase of an asset, on orders under 18 USD, carries a one-time opening fee of 0.35 to 0.45 USD. Withdrawals cost a flat 1 USD. Opening an account is free; there are no monthly or inactivity fees.

## Target audience

Spanish-speaking retail investors in Venezuela and Latin America who already use stablecoins for daily commerce and want access to U.S. equity markets.
